scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
scripts.generate:api: cd backend && uv run python -m app.scripts.export_openapi && cd ../frontend && pnpm generate:api
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check app
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
